open_points.text: - append_audit: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST validate the closed catalog intent and call repository.insert_audit exactly once for the caller-owned open unit of work; it MUST NOT commit, rollback, inspect repository internals, or catch/translate persistence errors; service actors MUST retain key_version and no secret/file_ref may enter details.
